author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a top-view airplane pointing up, with a round nose, fuselage visible above and below the wings, swept wings with round r5 tips, and flared tailplanes; reads as a plane. The rejected drawing was a lumpy blob. Earlier attempts read as a vase or an up arrow (attempts/).
omissions: The reference's rounded tailplane tips are drawn as small pointed flares: round tail tips come within 6 of the wing tips inside the square.
drawing_plan: SQUARE, mirror about x=24: nose r4 about (24,10); wing (20,14)-(8,23), r5 cap about (11,27), (14,31)-(18,28)-(20,28); wall to (20,37); tail flare to (15,42), tail end y42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'plane' top view; 3-4-5 round wing caps.
